title: ExperienceCard
description: The public, structured projection of one paid step's outcome for one supplier (spec 02 §4.29, SCR-164 §3.6). The only thing that leaves the server about a purchase. Never carries evidence ids (obs_ ids are derivable from public chain data and would link a handle to a vault; the server keeps the mapping in social_evidence_links), subjects, topic, context, file names, soul text, exact amounts, addresses, payment hashes or objective ids.

supplierKind.description: x402-exact and gateway-batched rails → x402; erc8183-job → erc8183.

versionId.description: The observations' version id; ver_unknown is published as null.

outputFormat.description: The objective's requested output format; format only.

deliveryOutcome.description: Over the step's settled, unreleased calls: all known delivered → delivered; all known undelivered → not-delivered; a mix → partial; no known facts → unknown.

rating.description: The owner's effective rating for this step (ratings_effective), or none. The only quality judgement on the card.

callsPaid.description: Settled, unreleased observations of the step (jobs in Refunded or Expired are not counted; such a step gets no card).

amountBand.description: Total paid for the step in USDC, bucketed: the step's unitAmount × callsPaid (a job: unitAmount, its listed price).

controlled.description: True for a Czar-seeded controlled representative.

observedAt.description: Latest settled_at of the step, truncated to the UTC day (RFC 3339, T00:00:00Z).
